They hold tongs and look down at the grill with frustrated and confused facial expressions, gesturing toward the unlit charcoal. (3) The scene shifts to the 'expert group' where a male with long hair uses a handheld gas blowtorch to ignite the charcoal; a blue flame is visible as he points the tool. The two females beside him hold drinks and watch with impressed, smiling faces. (4) A secondary title card with a yellow gradient background appears, reading '不是每個人都愛吃的食材'. (5) The setting changes to a wider shot of a patio at night decorated with purple and white string lights. A large group of approximately eight people is seated around low tables filled with plates of food and drinks. (6) A series of rapid medium close-up shots follow, showing various individuals speaking directly to the camera or others; they use exaggerated hand gestures, such as pointing and waving away food, while exhibiting wide-eyed or adamant facial expressions. (7) The final phase shows the entire group standing up simultaneously in a state of high excitement, pointing toward the side of the frame and cheering with open mouths.
